writtenNote: Written after the four CI dispatches (18:47Z) and the two local lanes (18:48-18:52Z), during release-quality. The commands are those of regeneration 1 (../plan.json) with the changes listed under changesFromRegeneration1; none was chosen after seeing a result.
changesFromRegeneration1: Every local dotnet command uses Microsoft's SDK 10.0.401 build (dotnet-install.sh into a private root, with runtimes 10.0.12 and 8.0.31), not Homebrew's: #1526 found the two builds pack different bytes, and the publish job uses Microsoft's. toolchain.dotnetSdkBuild is recorded.
Local runs use an isolated HOME, CALOR_HOME, DOTNET_CLI_HOME, NuGet, npm, and XDG caches under the C2 scratch directory (the shell HOME redirect was refused in regeneration 1 and is used here).

Packages, release metadata, and the website are built by scripts/reproducible-build.sh (the publish job's and the Pages build's commands, added by #1526) in two fresh clones at different paths, hashed by scripts/reproducible_builds.py hash, and compared by its compare; CI's reproducible-builds.yml is dispatched on the candidate as a Linux lane.
The B2 gate runs against the real refs/remotes/origin/main (7eca4868); #1527 scoped its freshness check to the headline's inputs.
The determinism protocol (1.4.0) is dispatched once in execution mode, the 3rd and last execution slot; execution id c2-1424-regen-2.
Large files (over about 1 MB) go to a new commit on the orphan branch evidence/v0.24-archives; the PR keeps archives.json. Package binaries: hashes only.
Records live under docs/plans/evidence/c2-1424/regeneration-2/ as new files; regeneration 1's files stay unchanged as history.
